summary: Separate conversation connections from retained Agent history, add a six-hour idle release policy and verified Codex app handoff, and bound diagnostic events while retaining usage and delivery provenance.
migration: Schema 14 backs up existing databases before batched cleanup. Early schema-14 test builds get one diagnostic rescan to apply every Job's event limit. THREAD_IDLE_MS defaults to six hours independently of result TTL; 0 disables automatic release. New installs use persistent visible threads; saved preferences and ephemeral/unknown contexts are preserved. Codex must release its writer before return.
